name: Scott E. Beachler
prior_offices: Weston County coroner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Scott E. Beachler is the Weston County coroner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The News Letter Journal reported that he was unopposed in the August 2026 Republican primary.

sources.name: News Letter Journal, Weston County certifies 2026 primary results
